# Third-Party Handover Checklist

Use this checklist to ensure clear understanding by someone not involved in the implementation.

- [ ] Clear statement of what changed
- [ ] Clear statement of why it changed
- [ ] Business impact explained in plain language
- [ ] Technical impact explained with affected artifacts
- [ ] Validation steps are executable and reproducible
- [ ] Containerized test commands are provided (if project is containerized)
- [ ] Risks and rollback are actionable
- [ ] Mermaid diagram explains the critical flow
- [ ] Open issues/limitations are explicit
- [ ] Reader can continue work without synchronous explanation
